scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Payroll Assistance (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
other_conditions: The industrial unit must be recognized as a Labour Intensive Unit.
Applicable to industrial units in the Garment, Apparel & Made‑ups, and Technical Textile sectors (including Composite Units).
Workers must be domiciled in Gujarat and registered under the EPF scheme.
The unit must apply within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).
benefits_summary: Provides payroll assistance of ₹5,000 per female and ₹4,000 per male worker per month for Garment/Apparel & Made‑ups units, and ₹3,000 per female and ₹2,000 per male worker per month for Technical Textile units, for up to 10 years.
